info.name: HOA Management System API — Springdale Village
info.description:
Complete REST API collection for the Springdale Village Homeowners Association Management System (Biñan City, Laguna).

**Base URL:** `{{base_url}}/api/v1`

**Authentication:** Laravel Sanctum — Bearer token. Run **Login** first; the token is auto-saved to `{{token}}` by the post-response script.

**Default seeded credentials:**
- SuperAdmin: `admin@springdale-hoa.ph`
- Board President: `rodrigo.aquino@springdale-hoa.ph`
- Treasurer: `lourdes.santos@springdale-hoa.ph`
- Resident: `carlos.reyes@gmail.com`
- Password (all): `Springdale@2026`

**Roles & permissions:**
- `super_admin` → full access (users, properties, financials, violations)
- `board_member` → financials + violations; read-only on users/properties
- `resident` → read-only on own property invoices and violations

**Uniform response envelope:**
```json
{ "success": true,  "message": "...", "data": { } }
{ "success": false, "message": "...", "errors": { } }
```

**Public identifiers:** All resources use **UUID** as the public-facing `id`. Route parameters (`:property`, `:user`, `:uuid`) and request-body FK fields (`property_id`, `user_uuid`) all accept UUIDs. The collection variables `{{property_id}}` and `{{user_id}}` hold UUID strings seeded from `migrate:fresh --seed`.

**Stack:** Laravel 11 · MySQL 8 · Sanctum 4 · PHP 8.2+

item.name: 👤 User Management
item.description:
CRUD operations for HOA user accounts.

**Authorization:** `super_admin` only for create / update / delete. All authenticated users can list and view.

**Roles:** `super_admin`, `board_member`, `resident`, `vendor`

**Public identifier:** All user routes use the `uuid` column. The `{{user_id}}` variable holds a UUID string.

request.description:
Returns a paginated list of all HOA user accounts. Available to all authenticated users.

25 users are seeded: 1 SuperAdmin, 4 board members, 17 residents, 3 vendors.

response.name: 200 – User List

request.description: Returns a single user by **UUID**. The `{{user_id}}` variable holds the UUID of Carlos M. Reyes (seeded resident).

Creates a new user account. **SuperAdmin only.**

**Required fields:** `name`, `email`, `password` (min 8 chars, mixed case + numbers), `role`

**Valid roles:** `super_admin`, `board_member`, `resident`, `vendor`

Partial update (PATCH). All fields are `sometimes` — send only what changes. **SuperAdmin only.**

Email uniqueness is validated against all rows except the user being updated (exclusion is by UUID).
Soft-deletes a user. The record remains in the database with a `deleted_at` timestamp. **SuperAdmin only.**

item.name: 🏠 Property Management
item.description:
Property (unit) CRUD and resident assignment.

**Authorization:**
- Create / Update: `super_admin` only
- Assign / Unassign resident: `super_admin` only
- View: all authenticated users

**Public identifier:** All property routes use the `uuid` column. The `{{property_id}}` variable holds the UUID of B1-L01 (seeded).

**Seeded properties (20 units across 5 blocks):**
```
B1-L01 … B1-L04  (Block 1 — Sampaguita Street)
B2-L01 … B2-L04  (Block 2 — Ilang-ilang Street)
B3-L01 … B3-L04  (Block 3 — Narra Street)
B4-L01 … B4-L04  (Block 4 — Molave Street)
B5-L01 … B5-L04  (Block 5 — Acacia Street)
```

response.name: 200 – Property List

request.description: Returns a single property by **UUID**, including its current residents. The `{{property_id}}` variable holds the UUID of B1-L01.

body.raw:
{
  "unit_number": "B6-L01",
  "block": "6",
  "street_address": "1 Mahogany Street, Springdale Village, Brgy. San Antonio, Biñan City, Laguna 4024",
  "type": "single_family",
  "monthly_dues": 1200.00,
  "late_fee_rate": 0.02,
  "is_active": true
}

request.description:
Creates a new property unit. **SuperAdmin only.**

`unit_number` must be unique. `late_fee_rate` is a decimal between 0 and 1 (e.g. `0.02` = 2%). A UUID is auto-generated for the new property.

request.description: Partial update. **SuperAdmin only.** `unit_number` uniqueness ignores the current record (exclusion is by UUID).

Links an existing user to a property via the `property_user` pivot table. Uses `syncWithoutDetaching` so multiple residents can share a unit without removing existing assignments.

**Field:** `user_uuid` — the UUID of the user to assign (use `{{user_id}}`).

**SuperAdmin only.**

response.name: 200 – Resident Assigned

request.description: Removes a resident from a property (detaches the pivot row). Both `:property` and `:user` path segments accept **UUIDs**. **SuperAdmin only.**

item.name: 💰 Financials — Invoices
item.description:
HOA dues ledger management.

**Authorization:**
- Generate / cancel / apply-late-fees / process-payment: `board_member` or `super_admin`
- View: all authenticated users (residents see own property only)

**Invoice lifecycle:** `pending` → `overdue` (late fees applied) → `paid` (auto on full payment) | `cancelled`

**Note:** `property_id` in request bodies is a **UUID string** (matches the `uuid` column, not the integer PK).

request.description:
Returns paginated invoices for a property identified by its **UUID**. Residents can only query their own property. Board members can query any.

The `{{property_id}}` variable holds the UUID of B1-L01 (6 seeded invoices).

Retrieves a single invoice by UUID. Includes the property and all payment records.

**Collection variables:**
- `{{invoice_paid}}` — status: paid
- `{{invoice_overdue}}` — status: overdue (with late fee)
- `{{invoice_pending}}` — status: pending

Generates a single HOA dues invoice for one property and period.

**Rules:**
- `property_id` — **UUID** of the property (use `{{property_id}}`)
- `period_month` in `Y-m` format (e.g. `2026-07`)
- Idempotent: returns `409` if invoice for this property + period already exists
- Due date auto-set to the 1st of the next month
- **Board member / SuperAdmin only**

response.name: 409 – Duplicate Period

request.description:
Generates monthly dues invoices for **all active properties** for the given period in one shot. Properties that already have an invoice for the period are silently skipped (idempotent).

Equivalent to running `php artisan hoa:generate-monthly-dues 2026-08` from the CLI.

**Board member / SuperAdmin only.**

body.raw:
{
  "amount": 816.00,
  "payment_method": "online",
  "transaction_reference": "GCH-20260521-98765",
  "notes": "GCash payment — March 2026 overdue dues + late fee.",
  "paid_at": "2026-05-21 10:30:00"
}

request.description:
Records a payment against an invoice (atomic DB transaction).

**Business rules:**
- Invoice must be `pending` or `overdue`; otherwise `409 Conflict`
- Invoice auto-transitions to `paid` when cumulative payments ≥ `total_amount`
- `received_by` defaults to the authenticated user if omitted

**Payment methods:** `cash`, `check`, `bank_transfer`, `credit_card`, `online`

response.name: 201 – Payment Recorded & Invoice Closed
409 – Invoice Not Settleable

request.description:
Cancels a `pending` or `overdue` invoice. Cannot cancel `paid` or already `cancelled` invoices.

**Board member / SuperAdmin only.**

response.name: 409 – Cannot Cancel (already paid)

request.description:
Batch operation. Scans all `pending` invoices whose `due_at` has passed, applies the property's `late_fee_rate` surcharge, and sets status to `overdue`. Each invoice update is wrapped in its own transaction.

Equivalent to `php artisan hoa:apply-late-fees`.

**Board member / SuperAdmin only.**

response.name: 200 – Late Fees Applied

item.name: 🚨 Violations
item.description:
Violation logging, state-machine transitions, and geotagged evidence management.

**State machine:**
```
Draft → Issued
Issued → Appealed | Paid | Resolved
Appealed → Issued | Resolved
Paid → Resolved
Resolved → ❌ (terminal)
```

On `Issued` transition, all property residents receive a queued mail notification (`ViolationIssuedNotification`).

**Note:** `property_id` in the Create Violation request body is a **UUID string**.

**Filter the list** with `?status=issued&property_id={{property_id}}`.

request.description:
Returns paginated violations ordered by `issued_at` descending.

**Optional query filters:**
- `?status=issued` — filter by status (any ViolationStatus value)
- `?property_id={{property_id}}` — filter by property **UUID**
- Combine: `?status=issued&property_id={{property_id}}`

**10 violations seeded across Springdale Village.**

response.name: 200 – All Violations

request.description: Returns full violation detail including property, reporter, geotagged evidence, and timestamps.

response.name: 200 – Issued Violation (B3-L01 Parking)

request.description:
Logs a new violation in `Draft` status. **Board member / SuperAdmin only.**

**`property_id`** must be the **UUID** of the target property (not an integer). The example uses the UUID of B2-L03.

GPS coordinates must be valid (lat -90..90, lng -180..180). Biñan City area: lat ≈ 14.34, lng ≈ 121.11.

`fine_amount` is optional at draft stage.

response.name: 201 – Violation Logged (Draft)
response.body:
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Violation report logged successfully.",
  "data": {
    "id": "019e4902-0000-7000-c000-000000000001",
    "property": { "unit_number": "B2-L03" },
    "reporter": { "name": "Rodrigo B. Aquino" },
    "title": "Illegal Fence Construction Beyond Property Line",
    "status": "draft",
    "status_label": "Draft",
    "fine_amount": "2500.00",
    "issued_at": null,
    "resolved_at": null
  }
}

request.description:
Transitions a violation through its state machine. Fires `ViolationStatusUpdated` event on success (queued listener sends mail notification to residents on `Issued`).

`409 Conflict` on invalid transitions (e.g. `draft → resolved`).

response.name: 409 – Invalid Transition (draft → resolved)

request.description:
Merges additional geotagged images into the violation's existing `evidence_images` JSON array (non-destructive). Max 10 images per request.

Request body uses only `evidence_images[]` — no `property_id` or `title` needed.

response.name: 200 – Evidence Appended (merged array)
